limitations: This is a three-record audit, not a database-wide validation.
Auntie Anne's VivoCity mall directory displays a general mall opening-hours footer; the brand's exact outlet locator is the more specific source and corroborates the workbook's 11:00am-9:30pm hours.
The URL normalization proposal is a canonicalization of a redirecting official URL, not a claim that the prior URL was false.
